description: Angular component for editing dashboard widgets, including configuration loading, mode switching, and change handling.

classes.name: EditWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and configuring dashboard widgets, managing form state, and widget configuration modes.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component and loads widget configuration.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, reloads configuration if widget or layout changes.

methods.name: onApplyWidgetConfig
methods.description: Emits event to apply current widget configuration if form is valid.

methods.name: onRevertWidgetConfig
methods.description: Emits event to revert widget configuration changes.

methods.name: loadWidgetConfig
methods.description: Loads and sets widget configuration data based on current widget and widget info.
